```typescript
// Retrieve details for a specific discovery item.
// Useful for showing event details to a user.

  try {
    const discoveryItem = await client.getDiscoverDiscoverId({ discoverId });
    console.log("Discovery Item Details:", discoveryItem);
    return discoveryItem;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching discovery item:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## Additional Notes

**Base URL:** `https://api.lu.ma`
**Auth:** Cookie-based (requires `luma.auth-session-key` from browser session)

## Authenticated Endpoints (require auth.json cookies)

### Get User's Events (registered/attending)
```
GET /home/get-events
```
Returns all events the user is registered for (upcoming and past).

### Get Subscribed Calendars
```
GET /home/get-subscribed-calendars
```

## Public Endpoints (no auth required)

### Get Events by Location
```
GET /discover/get-paginated-events?geo_latitude={lat}&geo_longitude={lng}&pagination_limit={limit}
```

**Example (Kuala Lumpur):**
```bash
curl "https://api.lu.ma/discover/get-paginated-events?geo_latitude=3.139&geo_longitude=101.6869&pagination_limit=20"
```

### Get Event Categories
```
GET /discover/category/list-categories
```

### Get Featured Calendars
```
GET /discover/get-calendars
```

### Get Bootstrap Page (featured content)
```
GET /discover/bootstrap-page
```

## Authentication

For authenticated endpoints, include these headers:
```
Cookie: luma.auth-session-key=<token>; luma.did=<device-id>
Origin: https://luma.com
Referer: https://luma.com/
```

The auth.json file contains the session cookies extracted from the browser.

## Response Format

Events are returned in `entries[]` array with:
- `event.name` - Event title
- `event.url` - Short URL slug (use with lu.ma/{slug})
- `event.start_at` - ISO timestamp (UTC)
- `event.timezone` - Local timezone
- `event.geo_address_info` - Location details
- `guest_count` - Number of attendees
- `ticket_info.is_free` - Whether free
- `ticket_info.spots_remaining` - Available spots
- `hosts[]` - Event organizers
